entry.name: mc.in~
entry.digest: Signal inputs for a patcher loaded by poly~
entry.description: The mc.in~ object receives signals from multiple inlets to the poly~ object (or multiple channels within the input to mcs.poly~), and outputs those signals as one multichannel signal. The number of signal inlets is determined by the chans attribute.

arguments.name: starting-inlet-number
arguments.description: Specifies the starting inlet number in aobject (default 1). If an argument of 2 is given, signal inlets will start with the second inlet and continue based on the number of input channels specified with theattribute.

attributes.name: chans
attributes.digest: Input Channels
attributes.description: Sets the number of input channels (default 1). If an argument of 4 is given (@chans 4), four signal inlets will be created in the containing poly~ object. The maximum number of channels for any singleobject is 128.
